official.description: The Pacific Scholarship for Excellence in Research & Innovation (PSERI) is a USP Research Office scholarship inviting applications from suitably qualified candidates to undertake a Masters degree or Doctor of Philosophy by research only at The University of the South Pacific. Awards are tenable from early 2026 and may be held in any member country of the USP, with the University keen to fund interdisciplinary projects that fall within its Strategic Research Themes.

applicant_utility.summary: PSERI is USP's flagship internally funded research degree scholarship, and the money is genuinely substantial: tuition and the compulsory fees are paid directly, a living allowance of FJD 21,600 per year for Master's or FJD 24,000 for PhD is paid monthly, and there is a book allowance, a dependants allowance and an establishment allowance on top. The catch is that the scholarship only buys the money, not the place - you must separately enrol in one of USP's academic units, and the award does not guarantee admission there. The other real constraint is the workload: full-time study, no paid employment for the whole tenure, a minimum 40 hours a week on research, and up to eight hours a week of teaching during semester. If you are a final year undergraduate, you can apply, but your letter must state your expected completion date or your file will not be assessable.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Citizens of a USP member country with a 3.5-plus undergraduate GPA who want a fully funded research Master's or PhD at USP and can commit to full-time, unpaid, 40-hour weeks on a Pacific-relevant research topic.
application_readiness_checklist: Secure certified true copies of your transcripts and certificates early - certified copies take days to obtain and are mandatory
Draft the research outline against one of USP's five Strategic Research Themes and against the specific unit you want to join, then check that unit's own website for what it supports this round
Contact a potential supervisor informally before you submit; the page explicitly allows applicants to discuss their application with one
Prepare the Applicant Detail Form and the Applicant Checklist, and complete every field rather than leaving blanks
Identify three referees and confirm their current contact details before you name them
Email everything in one message with the exact subject line format, rather than sending documents in several emails
If you are a final year undergraduate, state your expected completion date explicitly in the application letter
common_rejection_risks: Assuming the scholarship guarantees enrolment - you must enrol in the academic unit yourself, and a weak unit match sinks the application
A research outline that does not sit inside one of the Strategic Research Themes or inside what your target unit is funding this round
Missing the 3.5 undergraduate GPA threshold at Master's level; note the page also expects 3.5 or above in both undergraduate and postgraduate levels for applicants applying for a Masters award
PhD applicants without a completed Master's degree by thesis, which is an explicit requirement
Planning to work part-time alongside the award, which is prohibited for the whole tenure
Final year applicants who omit the expected completion date from their letter
Applying with a proposal that is not a research degree - PSERI covers Masters or PhD by research only
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Tuition, General Services fees, Health Services fees, the living allowance and the book allowance are covered, and one return airfare is provided when you have to travel to a USP campus in another country. The research grant is not guaranteed - it is only released once the research plan and budget are approved by the Academic Unit Research Committee - so fieldwork and data collection costs may initially sit with you. The dependants and establishment allowances are also conditional: the dependants allowance applies only to primary dependants who reside with you during the scholarship, and the establishment allowance requires relocating to a USP campus.
document_audit: Transcripts and certificates must be certified true copies, not plain photocopies or scans you print yourself

All eight documents travel in a single email - the Applicant Detail Form, the Applicant Checklist, the cover letter, the research outline, the CV, the three referees, the certified copies and proof of citizenship
Use the exact subject line format including your own name, because applications are triaged by subject line

If you claim a dependants allowance, you must document proof of marriage and the spouse's employment status, and for children prove the relationship, residence with you, age under 18 and your main and continuing support

If you claim an establishment allowance, you must show you are relocating from outside the greater Suva area, that neither you nor your partner is receiving a relocation package from another organisation, and that the award will run at least 12 months
alerts: The 2026 round closed at midnight on Monday 5 January 2026 and the page is marked CLOSED; USP publishes a new year-dated call each year, so watch the same page from late 2026
Enrolment in the academic unit is separate from the scholarship and is not guaranteed by it, so line up your academic admission in parallel
You cannot hold paid employment for the entire tenure of the award, so make sure you can live on the monthly living allowance
The research grant is gated behind AURC approval of both the research plan and the budget, so do not budget fieldwork money before that approval
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Assemble all eight documents, email them as one package to the USP Research Office postgraduate scholarships mailbox with the prescribed subject line, and follow up by email or with the Research Student Coordinator; enrolment in the academic unit is arranged separately once you are awarded.
